subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A chatbot can answer many simple questions, but it should not become a wall between people and help.”?
options: Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.
In a modern store, human service may become less visible but more important.
The best system knows when to stop pretending it understands and call a human.
The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.
